scope: Exclusively the 60 recorded Connect Four matches. No model inference, gameplay rollout, external benchmark, or external capability claims. Hypothetical legal moves are used only for deterministic one-ply board-rule checks.

definitions.win_percent: 100 * recorded wins / recorded completed games; each entrant played 30 games, 15 as X and 15 as O.
definitions.game_length: Total recorded plies from the empty board, partitioned into preset opening plies and model decisions (plus any forced rule moves). Shorter games do not alone establish superior play.
definitions.own_win: At a model decision, enumerate every gravity-legal move for the current player; opportunity exists iff at least one wins immediately. Taken iff chosen column is among those winning columns. Preset opening moves excluded.
definitions.safe_block: Only when the current player has no immediate winning move, the opponent has at least one immediate winning column in the current board, and at least one legal own move leaves zero opponent immediate winning moves. Taken iff chosen move leaves zero opponent immediate winning moves. Every legal candidate and every legal opponent reply is checked. Positions with no safe blocking move are counted separately, not as missed blocks.
definitions.tactical_limits: These are local immediate-win / one-reply safety checks, not solver-optimal moves or a measure of long-term strategic strength. Opportunity denominators differ across models and repeated inputs are correlated.
definitions.request_repetition: Exact SHA256 of the same full state/question/ordered legal choices. Per-model repeated-input counts are separate from requests shared across models. Choices compared only within the same model.
definitions.request_response_timing: Recorded decision.elapsed_ns converted to milliseconds: harness duration around the persistent adapter request/response call. Includes JSON/IPC and may include model startup/readiness wait on a first call; excludes harness evidence file writes and video timing. Not an intrinsic or controlled model speed ranking.
definitions.native_timing: Adapter metadata fields differ in scope: Dev inference_ms times Predictor.answer after a separate tokenization precheck; Kev inference_ms times probabilities after encoding; Von elapsed_ms covers native evaluate; Laya elapsed_ms includes normal and uncapped tokenization checks plus predict. These fields are not equivalent end-to-end measurements and exclude startup.
definitions.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; population SD is descriptive only.
definitions.inference_limits: 60 scheduled games using five fixed opening boards with swapped model seats; repeated exact requests and shared trajectories mean this is not 60 independent random trials. No broad model ranking or statistical certainty inferred.
